fact: The Secretary of State for the Digital Economy, Pedro Lopes, cited Cape Verde's modern laws on data protection and digital transactions among its regulatory progress; the document gives no law name or date, so the date used is its publication date, 2025-07-31.

Cape Verde's Decreto-Lei n.º 33/2007, published in the Boletim Oficial on 24 September 2007 and in force the day after, sets the legal regime for electronic signatures, certification entities and electronic contracting, and repeals Decreto-Lei 49/2003.
